verses.text: Ha juntzanh lolonel tik ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal ayik ayek' heb' t'a yol yik Moab, t'a slak'anil jun chonhab' Zuf t'a tzinan lu'um t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a ha' Jordán, haton t'a lum Arabá, haton lum ay t'a yichanh ha' Chakchak Mar. Ayek' heb' t'a snanhal chonhab' Parán yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' tik, haton Tofel, Labán, Hazerot yet' Dizahab. Ayik toxo ix satjiel chawanh heb' rey yuj winhaj Moisés yet' heb' soldado Israel, haton winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo kajan t'a Hesbón yet' winhaj Og sreyal Basán kajan t'a Astarot yet' t'a Edrei, hata' yal winhaj Moisés chi' tas schek Jehová yal winh t'a heb'. Huxluche' k'ual stek'nab'il t'a lum witz Horeb, sb'at t'a switzal Seir masanto sk'och t'a Cades-barnea. Wach'chom icha chi', palta ha t'a b'ab'el k'u yik yuxluchil uj yik stz'akwi 40 ab'il yelta heb' t'a Egipto, haton ta' ix yal winhaj Moisés tas syalelk'och juntzanh cheknab'il yalnak Jehová t'a winh yuj heb' schonhab'. Ix yalan winh icha tik:
Ha Jehová ko Diosal lolonnak t'ayonh t'a lum witz Horeb, yalannak icha tik: Niwanxo tiempo eyajek' t'a yichtak jun witz tik.

Ha tiknaik, ixikekxi, tzex b'atkan t'a lum switzal yik heb' amorreo yet' t'a masanil yol smakb'en heb' t'a Arabá, t'a tzalkixtak, t'a ch'olkixtak, t'a Neguev yet' t'a stitak ha' mar, t'a lum yik heb' Kananeo yet' t'a masanil yoltak yik Líbano masanto t'a ha' niwan Éufrates,

yujto toxo ix wak' lum lum chi' t'a yol he k'ab'. Ochanhek kajan t'ay yujto wak'nak in ti' wak'an lum t'a heb' he mam eyicham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob yet' t'ayex yinhtilal ex heb', xchi Jehová t'ayonh.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' walnak t'ayex: Manh ol yal-laj ex wilan in ch'okoj.
Tzijtum kuninal ix ak'ji yuj Jehová ko Diosal, yuj chi' a wal tiknaik, te niwan chonhab'xo onh aji, lajanxo ko b'isul icha k'e'en k'anal ay t'a satcha'anh to manh b'ischajb'enok.
Aokab' Jehová ko Diosal, sDiosal pax heb' ko mam kicham, a tz'ak'an k'ib' ko b'isul t'a smilalxo, ek'b'al t'a yichanh icha ko b'isul tiknaik. Yak'okab' wal swach'k'olal, icha wal ix aj yak'an sti'.
Yuj chi' max yal-laj wuj in ch'okoj ex wilani yet' in b'oanel masanil owal yet' chaklajb'ail ay t'a he kal.
Yuj chi', sik'ekel heb' winh te ay sjelanil t'a skal junjun inhtilal, haton heb' aj pensar, heb' ojtakab'ilxo to syal yuj, a juntzanh heb' chi' ol wak'och eyajalilok, xin chi.
Haxo he tak'wi: Scha ko k'o'ol masanil tas ix a na' chi', xe chi.

Icha chi' aj in sik'anel t'a skal junjun eyinhtilal heb' winh ay spensar, niwan yelk'ochi, wak'anoch yopisio heb' winh yoch eyajalilok: Ay heb' winh wak'och yajalil t'a mil anima, t'a cien, t'a cincuenta yet' t'a lajunhwanh, slaj och heb' winh yajalil chi' t'a yinhtilal.

Hanhejtona' wak'an juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' eyajalil chi': Tzeyila' tato ay owal ma telajb'ail sk'e wa'an t'a skal heb' ketchonhab', tato ay tas ay t'a skal chawanhok heb', mato ay tas ay t'a skal junok yet' junok ch'ok chonhab'il, wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'oan yaj t'a heb' t'a stojolal.

Ayik tze b'oan yaj t'a heb', malajokab' sk'exanhil heb' t'a yol he sat. Lajannhej tzeyutej t'a heb' emnakiltak yet' t'a heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Mokab'a junok b'aj tzex xiwi, yujto a jun eyopisio chi', manh eyikok, yujto ak'b'il t'ayex yuj Dios. Tato ay wal tas te niwan yaj jun, tzeyik'kot t'ayin, a inxo ol in b'o yaj t'a heb', xin chi t'a heb'.
Hata' walnak masanil t'a heb' tastak yowalil sk'ulej heb'.

Ayik kel t'a lum witz Horeb, ko t'inhb'anb'at t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik heb' amorreo, yuj ko k'anab'ajan tas syal Jehová ko Diosal. Te ay smay heyila' ayik onh ek'nhej t'a jun niwan tzinan lum chi', masanto onh k'och t'a Cades-barnea.
Hata' wal t'ayex to toxo onh k'och t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik heb' amorreo, haton jun chi' ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh.
Ochanhek an, ik'ek ek' lu'um, kajnajanhek ta', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayonh, haton ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham. Manh ex xiwok, mokab' chab'axk'e he k'o'ol, xin chi.

Ha exxo tik ul eyal t'ayin: Te wach' hama tato ay jaywanhok onh tzonh b'ab'laj b'ati yik tzonh b'at kil juntzanh chonhab' chi', tzonh paxta yik tzul kalani tas b'eal b'aj ol onh b'atok yet' tas chonhab'il b'aj ol onh ochok, xe chi.
Ha tas eyal chi', wach' wab'i. Yuj chi' in sik'el lajchawanh winak t'a he kal, junjun t'a junjun inhtilal.
Haton heb' chi' b'at t'a tzalkixtak, sk'och heb' t'a sch'olanil Escol, yek'chaj heb' t'a juntzanh lugar chi' smasanil.
Slajwi chi' yik'ankot heb' jab'ok sat tas awab'il t'a jun lu'um chi' t'ayonh. Ha yuj tas yal heb' chi', yuj chi' nachajel ku'uj to te wach' lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh.
Ha exxo tik, maj yal he k'ol ex b'at t'a jun lu'um chi', palta to he tenek' tas yal Jehová ko Diosal.
Haxo b'aj ayex ek' chi', ex och ijan eyalan icha tik: Ha Jehová malaj snib'ej t'ayonh, yuj chi' onh yik'elta t'a Egipto yujnhej onh yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' amorreo, yik tzonh satanel heb'.

Haxo tiknaik jun, ¿b'ajtil ol onh b'atok? Ha heb' ketchonhab' tz'alani to hata' ay heb' winh winak te tek'an, niwak winak, cha'anh ste'el heb' winh t'a kichanh, niwak chonhab' juntzanh schonhab' heb', te cha'anh yajoch smuroal spatiktak. Ix yilanpax juntzanh niwak winak yinhtilal winhaj Anac heb'. Ha yuj masanil juntzanh chi', junelnhej ix chab'axk'e ko k'o'ol, xe chi.
Ichato chi' in tak'wi: Manh ex xiw yuj juntzanh chi'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal ol b'ab'laj t'a kichanh, ha' ol ak'an owal ku'uj, icha wal tas ix aj kilan tas ix sk'ulej ku'uj t'a Egipto,
yet' t'a tzinan lu'um. Yet' wal yipal onh yik'ankot t'a yoltak b'e t'a tzinan lum chi', masanto ix yal ko jawi t'a tik, icha wal junok mamab'il to sya'ilej yal yuninal, xin chi.
Palta a ex tik maj eyak'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a he k'o'ol.
Ha wal Jehová chi' b'ab'el t'a kichanh. Ha t'ak'walil syak' sakil k'inal t'ayonh icha junok k'ak', haxo t'a k'ualil, sch'oxpax yet' jun asun b'aj tzonh b'ati yet' b'aj tzonh och wa'an.
Ayik yab'an Jehová tas eyal chi', te kot yowal, yak'an sti' icha tik:
Malaj wal junok juntzanh winak te chuk spensar tik ol ilan lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a he mam eyicham.
Anhej winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone ol ilan lu'um, yuj chi' ha t'a winh yet' yinhtilal ol wak' lum xit' eyil chi', yujto ix sk'anab'ajej winh yet' smasanil sk'ol tas ix wala', xchi Jehová chi'.
Eyuj wal a ex tik, yuj chi' kotpax yowal Jehová t'ayin, yalan t'ayin icha tik: Manh ol ach ochpaxlaj t'a lu'um a ach tik.

Ha winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun skolwaj het'ok, a winh ol och a k'exulok. Yuj chi' iptzitej winh yujto a winh ol ak'an jun lu'um chi' t'a heb' etisraelal tik, xchi t'ayin. Yalanpax t'ayex icha tik:

Wach'chom a ex tik tzeyak'och t'a he k'o'ol to ol ochkan heb' eyuninal chekab'ok t'a heb' ajk'o'ol, palta a heb' eyuninal mantalaj spensar chi', ol och heb' t'a jun lu'um chi'. Ha in ol wak' lum smakb'enok heb'.
Yakb'an manto elk'ochlaj, meltzajanhek t'a tzinan lu'um, tzex b'atkan junelxo t'a b'e sk'och t'a ha' Chakchak Mar, xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.

Ha ex tik, eyal t'ayin icha tik: Ix och ko mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal, palta a tiknaik jun, koyek, kak'ek kip icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayonh, xe chi. Eyik'anb'at eyamk'ab' yik owal, a he na'ani to sekojtak ol aj eyik'an lum tzalkixtak chi'.

Palta a Jehová halani to swal t'ayex: Manh eyak' owal, manh he tek'b'ej he b'a t'a heb' ajk'o'ol, haxo talaj tz'aji tzex yak'an ganar heb', yujto manh ol in b'atlaj heyet'ok, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Wak' juntzanh chi' eyojtakejeli, palta a ex tik maj he chalaj eyab'i. Haxo aji, he tenek' tas yal Jehová chi', eyak'an icha he gana, k'e ex t'a tzalkixtak chi'.
Yuj chi' a heb' amorreo kajan ta', elta heb' t'ayex icha nok' nok'al chab', masanto yal ex yak'an ganar heb' t'a Seir, k'ochnhej heb' t'a Horma.
Haxo yik ex meltzaj jun, och ex ijan eyok' t'a yichanh Jehová, palta majxo tak'woklaj t'ayex.
Yuj chi' te niwan tiempoal onh ek' t'a yol smakb'en Cades chi'.
